description: Real SEC 10-Q filing-pair benchmark with human-reviewed seed labels, Round 1 source-traceable candidate expansion, and automated second-pass review metadata.
limitations: Approved labels are human-reviewed gold labels; candidate labels are not gold until a human reviewer explicitly approves them.
Automated review metadata supports a provisional track only and must not be reported as human gold.
Round 1 candidate expansion stores SEC identifiers, short excerpts, and reviewability metadata only; full filing text is reconstructed from official SEC URLs when needed.
Real SEC evaluator may report NOT_EVALUATED for tasks without system predictions or sufficient approved labels.
Standard CI remains offline and deterministic; live SEC refresh is a separate explicit workflow.
